units.source_text: 侍女禀告公子：“敝寓异常秽陋，蒙公子大驾光临，多多委屈了！

en.t: A maid reported to the young lord, "This humble dwelling is terribly shabby and unclean; your gracious visit here must be a great hardship for you!

units.source_text: 仓促不及准备，只得就在此陋室请坐，乞恕简慢之罪！”

en.t: We had no time to prepare in this haste, so we can only ask you to sit in this poor room. Please forgive our rudeness and neglect."

units.source_text: 源氏公子觉得这地方的确异乎寻常。

en.t: Prince Genji felt that the place was indeed quite out of the ordinary.

units.source_text: 便答道：“我常想前来问候。

en.t: He replied, "I have often wished to come and pay my respects.

units.source_text: 只缘所请之事，屡蒙见拒，故而踌躇未敢相扰。

en.t: But because the matter I asked about was refused again and again, I hesitated and did not dare trouble you.

units.source_text: 师姑玉体违和，我亦未能早悉，实甚抱歉。”

en.t: I am truly sorry that I did not learn sooner that the reverend lady was unwell."

units.source_text: 老尼姑命侍女传言道：“老身一向疾病缠绵。

en.t: The old nun had the maid convey her words: "This old body of mine has long been burdened by illness.

units.source_text: 今大限将至，猥蒙公子亲临慰问，不能亲起迎候为歉。

en.t: Now that my final hour is near, I am deeply ashamed that although you have come in person to comfort me, I cannot rise to greet you myself.

units.source_text: 前所嘱一节，倘公子终不变心，则且待年事稍长之后，定当令其前来忝列后房。

en.t: As for the matter I spoke of before, if your feelings remain unchanged, then when she is a little older I will certainly have her come to you, unworthy though she is, to join your household.

units.source_text: 老身弃此伶仃弱女而去，亦不能瞑目往生西方也。”

en.t: If I leave this lonely, helpless young girl behind when I go, I will not be able to close my eyes and pass peacefully to the Western Paradise."

units.source_text: 老尼姑的病房离此甚近，她那凄凉的话声，源氏公子断断续续地听到。

en.t: The old nun's sickroom was very close by, and Prince Genji heard her sorrowful voice in broken fragments.

units.source_text: 但听见她继续说道：“真不敢当啊！

en.t: He heard her continue, "This is truly more than I deserve!

units.source_text: 要是这孩子到了答谢的年龄就好了。”

en.t: If only the child were old enough to offer her thanks."

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了这话，颇为感动，便说：“若非情谊深挚，我岂肯抛头露面，在人前作此热狂之态？

en.t: Prince Genji was deeply moved by these words and said, "If my feelings were not profound and sincere, would I expose myself like this and show such passionate emotion before others?

units.source_text: 不知有何宿缘，偶尔一见，便倾心相慕。

en.t: I do not know what bond from a former life exists between us, but after one chance glimpse, my whole heart turned toward her in longing.

units.source_text: 此真不可思议之事，定是前生早有注定也。”

en.t: It is truly a mysterious thing, and it must surely have been destined in a previous life."

units.source_text: 接着又说：“今日特地奉访，倘就此辞去，未免扫兴。

en.t: Then he added, "I came here especially today, and if I were to leave just like this, it would be rather disappointing.

units.source_text: 但愿一闻小姐天真烂漫之娇音，不知可否？”

en.t: I only wish to hear the young lady's innocent and lovely voice once. Might that be possible?"

units.source_text: 侍女答道：“此事实难奉命，姑娘无知无识，目下正在酣睡呢。”

en.t: The maid replied, "That is truly difficult to obey. The young lady is still too innocent to understand anything, and at the moment she is sleeping soundly."
